title: 20 March 1962: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
content:
This was The Beatles’ 61st evening show at the Cavern Club. They were second on a bill headlined by The Blue Genes, and which also featured Ian and the Zodiacs.

Overall this was The Beatles’ 155th appearance at the underground Mathew Street venue, including their lunchtime shows.

The precise number of the group’s Cavern performances is not known, although they played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows between 9 February 1961 and 3 August 1963.
